rule: One district per city: the closest match to Ghent (historic, walkable, early-twentieth-century residential fabric with small neighborhood shops). From it, asking rents for ground-floor shop space listed in 2024 or later, triple net or 'plus expenses', under about 4,500 sq ft. Metro averages, undated listing-site averages, figures with unclear units, and anything older than 2024 are left out. Gathered 2026-11-28 by a research pass; 'checked' says whether the figure was then read again from its page (twice) or the listing site refused a second look (once).

left_out.why: No district-level figure from 2024 or later: the best found is a 2018 city-commissioned study (the Downtown submarket at $21.19). The metro's Q2 2026 net asking rent is $23.59 (Cushman & Wakefield Thalhimer), but that's the whole metro, not a district like Ghent.
